project_name.justification: The authoritative project name is 'Millertown Junction Road'. The text confirms this: 'Great Atlantic Stakes Millertown Junction Gold Property' and '...staked a mineral licence (Millertown Junction Road Property)...'

company_name.justification: The text identifies the company making the announcement as 'GREAT ATLANTIC RESOURCES CORP. (TSXV: GR) (the "Company" or "Great Atlantic") is pleased to announce its wholly owned subsidiary, Golden Promise Mines Inc., has staked a mineral licence (Millertown Junction Road Property)...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed 'On Behalf of the board of directors "Christopher R. Anderson" Mr. Christopher R. Anderson President CEO Director'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Great Atlantic's 'wholly owned subsidiary, Golden Promise Mines Inc., has staked a mineral licence (Millertown Junction Road Property)'. Staking a new license from the government implies a 100% interest.

primary_commodity.justification: The headline of the article is 'Great Atlantic Stakes Millertown Junction Gold Property...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the staking of the Millertown Junction Road Property, which matches the project of interest. The source URL is provided at the bottom of the text: 'To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/234046'.

currency.justification: No financial transaction details involving cash or shares are mentioned, as the acquisition was a staking of a mineral license.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction described is a 'staking' of a mineral license, not a purchase from another company. No cash payment is mentioned.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction described is a 'staking' of a mineral license. No payment in shares is mentioned.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction described is a 'staking' of a mineral license. No combined cash and share payment is mentioned.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction described is a 'staking' of a mineral license. No shares were issued as part of the transaction.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction described is a 'staking' of a mineral license. No shares were issued, so there is no associated share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters is mentioned in the text.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The text states: 'It covers an area of 425 hectares.'
